name: claude-mods
description: Personal Claude Code mods: usage cockpit, subagent progress, file tree and ask-before-save memory.

plugins.name: cockpit
plugins.description: Usage band and panel, model and effort advisor, budget guard, /handoff, cache timer.

plugins.name: savvy-progress-plus
plugins.description: Progress bar for multi-step work and a /crew panel of subagents (fork of savvy-progress).

plugins.name: workspace
plugins.description: Read-only file tree pane (/tree) with marks on files Claude read, edited or created.

plugins.name: memory
plugins.description: Spots your preferences and asks before saving each one to CLAUDE.md.

plugins.name: launcher
plugins.description: Mode buttons (STUDY, TECH, DEEP…), EN/FR/AR, shortcuts to your mods, and a glossary side panel.

plugins.name: taskboard
plugins.description: Crab task board: one crab per task, live activity line, timeline, /taskboard.

plugins.name: companion
plugins.description: Animated Lagoon in the left sidebar, mood crab, done alerts with a crab chirp, celebrations. /lagoon toggles the theme.

plugins.name: guard
plugins.description: Asks before destructive commands, blocks secrets from being written, checkpoints every edit with /undo-edit and /checkpoints.
